open_points.subject: ProgressPhoto binary delivery failure classification
open_points.text: R0-12 says “a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as a storage error,” while A14 says “A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure.”
open_points.question: When an authorized, client-visible ProgressPhoto references missing stored content, is the failure a storage error or an unavailable/not-found failure?
options: Classify missing photo content as a storage error under R0-12.
Classify missing photo content as unavailable/not-found under A14.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the newer accepted R0-12 change and classify it as a storage error.

witness.initial: An active viewer has an active grant to an active project; a client-visible ProgressPhoto in that project has a file_ref whose source object is missing.
events: The viewer requests the photo binary by photo_id.
The photo module authorizes the viewer and passes the reference to binary storage.
Binary storage cannot find the referenced object.
outcomes: A14 requires an explicit unavailable/not-found failure.
witness.observer: The binary endpoint and its authorized caller, through the resulting error classification and HTTP mapping.
